facts.fact: UNESCWA's December 2025 Comoros anti-corruption profile says transparency is not yet clearly defined in the legislative framework and recommends developing a law guaranteeing the right to access information, so none is in place.
UNESCWA's profile of the legal framework in force as of December 2025 states that Comoros has "no comprehensive data protection law in place" and recommends developing one.

COM.note: The document is an anti-corruption legal profile and says nothing about local government office connections.
